That observation is the METER's dialect, not SEAFLO's. The reading is attributed to the energy meter device; a pump inferred from it is an inference the rule engine makes, and it must not be published as a pump reading.

A circulation pump is usually a continuous-duty part with no pressure switch at all — it runs whenever it has power. Unconfirmed for these, but if true it means the same dry-run and run-time responsibility as the bare-motor group applies. Confirm before wiring a relay.
